Based on the official tauri-plugin-http 2.5.9 crate from crates.io.
The JavaScript API and command names remain compatible with 2.5.9.

BDEngine changes:
- Serialize native errors as {code, message}, without URLs or credentials.
- Disable automatic request retries.
- Release completed request resources and reject responses from a closed page.
- Serialize response readers safely and cancel in-flight body reads when their
  resource is closed, including page navigation cleanup.
- Make repeated cancellation harmless.

The original Apache-2.0 and MIT licenses are preserved alongside this file.
